# Test fixtures

`forceartgs_synthetic_{revolute,prismatic}_s0/` are UNMODIFIED outputs (`joint_candidates.json`,
`joint_states.npz`) of Samuele Mara's ForceArtGS, commit `886d49eed435e06babed8b69723082facdd4d3fb`
(https://github.com/SamueleMara/ForceArtGS, Apache-2.0), produced on 2026-11-19 with

    python -B -m estimotion_2part.joint_discovery.cli synthetic --kind <revolute|prismatic> --seed 0 --output <dir>

(defaults: 12 frames at 10 fps, revolute max 40 deg about +x through (0, 0.1, 0.13) m, prismatic max 0.12 m along -y).
They exercise the Level-B kinematic contract: joint type, sign-canonicalised axis + q, origin, timestamps,
validity mask and the selection decision. The robot force record of the tests is generated by
`examples/forceartgs_synthetic_robot.py` (ForceArtGS' synthetic contact force is a constant 6 N and is not
dynamics-consistent).
